$description: Authored. The track, and what each stretch of it is, in song bars (bar 1 is the first downbeat the analysis finds). The analysis never writes this file; it reads the labels to annotate spectrograms and cues.
title: PartyInvaders (original)
license: Not cleared. Confirm permission from the artist before the video is published.

sections.what: Four-on-the-floor kick and a held low drone
Arcade blips scatter over the kick
Sidechained synths pump on every kick; zaps up top
The bass filters out over bar 7; bar 8 is near silent
Full groove and a square-wave melody; bar 16 stops and starts, then a hole and a swoosh
First drop: the biggest single hit lands on bar 17
Kick on 1 and 3, a 3-3-2 snare, mids build for twelve bars
The sub drops away, highs rise; bar 50 stutters
Bar 51 is a noise riser; bar 52 is the gap
Held bass notes, a backbeat on 2 and 4
Brighter; bar 68 pulls back in its second half
The peak: the loudest, brightest bars
One hit, and its decay to silence
